hypothesis: The qualified points engine disables all null-move pruning. A guarded null probe followed by mandatory non-null verification may reduce wasted search enough to improve playing strength with the unchanged winning evaluation.

policy_frozen_before_panel.ordinary_eligibility: Keep existing cut-node, static-evaluation, non-pawn-material and excluded-move conditions
policy_frozen_before_panel.points_extra_eligibility: depth >= 4; no verification already active; beta outside decisive score range; rule50_count + depth < 100
policy_frozen_before_panel.reduction: Existing dynamic reduction, capped at depth - 2 for points
policy_frozen_before_panel.verification: Every eligible nondecisive null fail-high must pass a search from the original position, at depth - R >= 2, with null pruning disabled throughout that verification subtree
policy_frozen_before_panel.returned_bound: Return the real-position verification value for points; preserve legacy behavior
policy_frozen_before_panel.terminal_rules: Existing point settlements, resignation claims and mate logic remain ahead of the probe
